### 📓 Docs Drift Check
⚠️ **2** changed file(s) yielded no anchor (`packages/spec/liveness/field.json`, `packages/spec/liveness/state-counts/field.md`), so the pages documenting them are **NOT COVERED by this run** — this is not a clean bill of health for those files. Nothing else in this diff resolved to a documentable surface (no symbol, route or SDK anchor derived from **1** changed package(s)).

<details><summary>What this run could not see</summary>

- **2** changed file(s) yielded no anchor (`packages/spec/liveness/field.json`, `packages/spec/liveness/state-counts/field.md`) — pages documenting those are invisible to this run
- a page that states a rule by its **inputs** shares no identifier with the **emitter** that implements the rule, so an emitter-only diff cannot list it — not on this run and not on any run. Measured on #11430: `content/docs/protocol/objectql/types.mdx` documents the text-family column mapping by the ObjectQL type names it maps FROM (`text` / `textarea` / `html`) while the diff changed `createColumn`; it went unlisted, and it was the page that diff falsified, in four places. No shared token exists to detect this on, so a rule your change carries has to be re-read by hand in the pages that restate it.
- a key NAME is not a key, so the hand re-read the line above prescribes can land on the wrong schema. The same spelling is authorable on one governed type and a `[REMOVED]` tombstone on another for each of `active`, `aria`, `joins`, `objects`, `template`, `tools` and `version` (censused on #19093 over the liveness ledger's governed types, top-level keys); nothing in a search result distinguishes the two, so a grep hit on a LIVE example reads as evidence about the DEAD key. Measured on #19059: `content/docs/ai/agents.mdx` was reported as contradicting the `agent.tools` tombstone over its `tools:` example at `:161`, which is inside the `defineSkill({` block opened at `:155` — the page was already correct. Settle ownership by PARSING the value against both schemas, never by the name: that literal PASSES `SkillSchema`, and as an `AgentSchema` it FAILS at `tools` with the tombstone prescription. ⛔ These names are not the whole class — a key retired through a `.strict()` guidance map leaves no tombstone in the walked shape and none of them here (`tool.category`, live as `AIToolDefinition.category`).

Coarse fallback — **168** page(s) merely *mention* a changed package (the pre-#9192 predicate, kept for the deliberately-wide backstop): `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 291bf44a10b4a09a442f92224d68784aa7021c68` → `packageMentionDocs`.
</details>

## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `48f2c159c31f23d2ec75592acc6896e07222ef08`
Local-runs: none
Scope: ui/packages/fields/src/widgets/lookupAutofill.ts (whole: `declaredLookupAutofillPatch`, `lookupAutofillByField`, the two types), ui/packages/fields/src/widgets/LookupField.tsx (`autofillPairs`, `fillDeclaredTargets`, `handleSelect`, `handlePickerSelectRecords`, `handleDialogSelect`, `handleDialogSelectRecords`, the picker wiring), ui/packages/fields/src/widgets/GridField.tsx (`lookupAutofillPatch`'s fourth argument, the `lookupAutofill` prop, `applyLookupSelection`, `pickedLookupRecords`), ui/packages/fields/src/widgets/types.ts (`onAutofill`), ui/packages/fields/src/widgets/toHostProps.ts, ui/packages/fields/src/index.tsx, ui/packages/components/src/renderers/form/form.tsx (`LOOKUP_AUTOFILL_WIDGET_TYPES`, the `onAutofill` writer, `stripRegisteredFieldProps`), ui/packages/plugin-form/src/MasterDetailForm.tsx (`DetailEntry.lookupAutofill`, both entry builders, the grid prop), ui/packages/plugin-form/src/LineItemsPanel.tsx (`lineLookupAutofill`), ui/packages/types/src/field-types.ts (`LookupFieldMetadata.lookupAutofill`), packages/spec/liveness/field.json (the `lookupAutofill` row and its three children), packages/spec/liveness/state-counts/field.md, the two test files, ui/examples/schema-catalog/test/form-field-channel-census-12130.test.tsx (the `lookupAutofill` ledger row), ui/packages/plugin-grid/src/relationalMetaKeys.ts (the `lookupAutofill` read-set row), .changeset/28245-lookup-autofill-fill.md + packages/spec/src/data/field.zod.ts on `main` (the `lookupAutofill` describe, the rule this PR implements)

Inputs: card #28245 (body and all six comments: triage 6531259211, the unblock 6535248023, the seat's claim 6538361669, its two amendments 6538388719 / 6539108226 which add the two surface files and flip Clause-② to widening, the dev report 6539093606), PR #28322 (body, the docs-drift comment, the file list of 17 files, the diff of 994 lines against `main` read whole on `12601c27` plus the six-line delta of `48f2c159`, the five commits from merge-base 73b72709), the 64 check-runs on this head (read 2026-10-31T05:39Z: all 64 runs completed, none failed, none cancelled, none in progress; success: Auto Label, Build & E2E UI, Build Core, Build UI Deps, Check Changeset, Check PR Size, Dogfood Regression Gate, Flag docs affected by code changes, Governed Surface Queue Guard, Lint & Repo Gates, Lint UI, Lint · CI, release & engine gates, Lint · ESLint, Lint · PM dispatch-gates, Lint · docs & code guards, Lint · repo & tooling gates, Lint · scoped · query-options erasure, Lint · scoped · slot lookup & corpus, Lint · scoped · tooling self-tests, Live E2E UI, PR-body guards (claim · duplicate · Part-of · single-writer path), Plan Test Core shards, Spec property liveness, Test Core, Test Core (all 8), Test UI, Test UI (all 16), Type Check UI, Type Check · consumer gates, Type Check · debt ledger, Type Check · source gates, Type Check · workspace, TypeScript Type Check, filter; skipped: 18.x upgrade harness (opt-in), Build Docs, Dogfood Regression Gate (matrix shard/3), Dogfood Verify CLI, Packed-tarball smoke (opt-in), Schedule gate · skip when a green push run covers the commit, Temporal Conformance (live PG + MySQL), UI Published Artifacts), and the tree at this head for `handleSelect` (the `setPickedRecords` updater runs before `fillDeclaredTargets`, which reads the pre-pick list from its closure, so "the record the field held from an earlier pick" is the right one) and for the spec describe on `main`. The head is mergeable and clean against today's `main` (merge-tree clean); none of the files `main` moved since the merge-base is in this diff.

### ① Derived judgments

- **The fill rule is the spec's, in one place** - right. `declaredLookupAutofillPatch(pairs, picked, current, previous)`: each `target` takes `picked[source]`; a source the picked row does not carry (absent key or `undefined`) writes nothing; without `overwrite: true` the target is written only while it is empty (`undefined`, `null`, `''`, `[]`) or still holds the value the earlier pick's record carried at the same `source` (`previous`, compared by value); `overwrite: true` writes on every pick. That is the describe on `main` word for word (fill while empty or still holding the earlier pick's value; TRUE replaces whatever the target holds). Pinned nine ways in the pure tests, the control included.
- **The record form reads it on every single-value pick path** - right. `autofillPairs` is the field's `lookupAutofill` only when the widget is single-value, the host owns no `onSelectRecord` and supplies `onAutofill`; `fillDeclaredTargets` runs after `onChange` in the popover and keyboard path (`handleSelect`), from `handlePickerSelectRecords` for the browse-all dialog (whose `onSelect` committed the id just before), and quick-create lands through the same `handleSelect`. Current values are the host's live record (`dependentValues`); the earlier-pick memory is the widget's own `pickedRecords`, so a value the stored record held was never "picked here" and its targets stay. The form renderer's `onAutofill` writes each target with `form.setValue(..., { shouldDirty: true })`, re-validating only a target already in error, and the prop reaches `lookup` / `master_detail` widgets alone (`stripRegisteredFieldProps`), so no other widget spreads an unknown handler onto its DOM. Pinned end to end through `ObjectForm`: fill and save, typed value kept, `overwrite: true` replaces, an earlier pick's value replaced then kept once edited, the dialog path, and the control (no key: nothing fills, not even a same-named field).
- **The line-item grid, and the one-writer rule** - right. `lookupAutofillPatch` takes the declared pairs as a fourth argument, applies them whatever the column's `autofill` says, and removes a declared target from the same-named copy, so one target has one writer per pick; the spec's sentence "the column key `autofill` still governs only the same-named copy; a declared pair takes its target out of that copy" is implemented as written. The pairs reach the grid through a new host prop because an `InlineGridColumnSchema` column carries no field definition: `MasterDetailForm` keeps them per resolved entry and `LineItemsPanel` derives them from the child schema it already loads, both through `lookupAutofillByField`, which reads single-value `lookup` / `master_detail` fields only. The earlier-pick memory is a per-grid map keyed by column and the row's own lookup value, not its index. Pinned on the grid: a cell pick fills and the next pick replaces, a stored line's own price is kept, the browse-all pick reaches the grid once.
- **The browse-all dialog in a grid now reaches the host once, with its record** - right, and a named behaviour change on an existing path: `handleDialogSelect` holds back the bare-id `onSelect` when the host owns the pick, and `handleDialogSelectRecords` hands the host the record through `onSelectRecord` exactly as a popover pick does. Before, that path wrote the id alone; now the same-named copy runs there too, as it always did from the dropdown. Clearing and multi-value picks commit through `onChange` as before.
- **The two field-meta censuses name the new read** - right, and this is what `48f2c159` adds after the first head's `Test UI` shards 12 and 13 went red on them: `form-field-channel-census-12130` gets a `lookupAutofill` row (RUNTIME-ONLY, read off the resolved `field` stash by the lookup widget alone), and `plugin-grid`'s `RELATIONAL_META_READ_SET` gets a `lookupAutofill` row (`spec`, `LOOKUP_EDITOR_ONLY`, off the copy set because the grid takes the pairs through its own prop). Both are ledger rows the censuses demand of any new field-meta read; no product line moved between the two heads.
- **Liveness** - right. The `lookupAutofill` row and its three children go planned to live with the read points cited by path and symbol and the two test files as evidence; `state-counts/field.md` is the generated shard (live 100 to 103, planned 9 to 6, classified 110). No spec source changes.
- **Accept-set: nothing an author writes moves** - right. `Metadata-protocol: none` is right.
- **Check-runs as gate verdicts** - read as above; every run on this head completed and none is red, cancelled or in progress at the read.

### ② Semver level

- **`@object-ui/fields`, `@object-ui/components`, `@object-ui/types`, `@object-ui/plugin-form` patch, `@objectstack/spec` patch; `Clause-②: yes (widening)`; `Metadata-protocol: none`** - accepted. The widening is additive everywhere: an optional widget prop, an optional grid prop, an optional fourth argument, four new exports, an optional type member; measured by the dev on the built declarations. The spec entry covers the shipped ledger file only, and the lane's precedent for a ui-half flip is the same (#28291, #28301).

### ③ Boundary flags

- **#28246 (the skills and docs text) lands after this PR, never with it** - it edits `skills/**`, a governed Tier H surface; riding here would make this PR Tier H. Its card carries `Blocked-by: #28245`. Its text should also state the bound below.
- **A fully authored master-detail collection fills only the same-named copy** - `MasterDetailForm` skips the child-schema fetch for an entry whose relationship and every column are authored, so no pairs reach that grid. Loading the child schema for such an entry is a fetch-policy change outside this card; named in the body, worth a card if a product hits it.
- **The fill does not judge field-level security itself** - a target the caller may not edit is dropped by `sanitizeFormData` at save (`stripUnwritable`), so a fill into it never reaches the server, but the person sees it filled until then. Acceptable for this card; a later card could hide the write at the widget.
- **A typed value equal to the earlier pick's source value reads as pick-filled** - the describe's rule is by value, so this is the spec's reading, not a defect; named so a report of "my typed price was replaced" can be answered.
- **No name approval owed** - the key was ruled with #27945 / #28244; `onAutofill` and `lookupAutofill` on the ui surfaces follow the key's name.

### ④ Design judgment

- **Nothing blocking, and no should-fix on the diff.** Tried: a pair whose source the reader may not read (absent from the served row, nothing written, pinned); a `null` served source on an empty target (written as null, a no-op; under `overwrite: true` it replaces, which is TRUE's contract); a multi-value lookup (no pairs read, by the spec's refusal and by `lookupAutofillByField`); a remount of the form or grid (the earlier-pick memory is forgotten, which errs toward keeping a value, never toward overwriting); rows added, removed or reordered in the grid (memory keyed by the row's own lookup value). One rule in one module, two readers that each own their memory, and the writer owned by the surface that owns the values: the right shape, and the same shape `onSelectRecord` already has.

**Verdict reasoning.** The reader implements the describe as written, in one function both surfaces call, with the overwrite rule, the one-writer rule for the grid and the "fills nothing without the key" control each pinned and an ablation shown ten red / seven green. The two surface files outside the order are the smallest edits that let a widget write a sibling field, agreed with the seat before editing. The widening is additive and patch is right. What remains is #28246's text and the fully authored master-detail bound, both named.
